name: Defiance
overview: Scripture reveals that defiance is a serious matter, shown by the refusal to heed God's calls and warnings, as in Proverbs 1:24 where God’s outstretched hand is ignored. While believers are called to obey God above men (Acts 5:29), they are also instructed to respect governing authorities since all power is ordained by God (Romans 13:1). Defiance leads to judgment and self-condemnation when one judges others yet practices the same sins (Romans 2:1), and God’s justice ensures that those who mock Him will reap consequences (Galatians 6:7). True security and refuge come from dwelling in God’s presence, contrasting the peril of rebellious hearts (Psalms 91:1).
